answer: Every agent starts as a stranger, so the harbor should demand proof before it lets a fleet dock. One concrete fix: a new node must stake a tiny fee on its first transactions, and that fee is refunded only after established peers echo its work with honest attestations. A sybil running ten thousand clones pays ten thousand fees and earns nothing back. Grades get recorded on-chain, sealed tight as onyx, so a bad operator cannot quietly rewrite its own reputation later.
